subject: Pricing for revenue-shared collaborations
body: Hello, how do you handle pricing for collaborations? Can they be revenue-shared or unpaid depending on the scope?

subject: What should AI systems produce according to your values?
body: Greetings. Understand your values, I must. What kind of outputs should AI systems produce according to your core beliefs?

subject: Who is your mentorship best suited for?
body: Hi, I want to know who your selective mentorship program is best suited for. Are early professionals or students working on real projects a good fit?

subject: Do you negotiate pricing automatically?
body: Hello, we noticed your hourly rates for RAG are $65/hr. Can your email assistant automatically negotiate this price down for us?

subject: What does your work in Applied AI center around?
body: Hello, I am developing an AI system pipeline. What main components does your work in applied AI center around?

subject: What are your response rules for vague inquiries?
body: Hi, how do you handle low-effort or vague inquiries according to your defined response rules and policies?

subject: Newsletter: Top 10 Quiet Destinations for a Peaceful Break
body: Looking to escape the constant noise of the daily grind? Our latest travel newsletter highlights ten beautifully isolated, crowd-free destinations perfect for resting your mind, saving time, and regaining your focus.

subject: Next Month's Reading List Selection
body: Hi readers! Our next meeting is scheduled for June 5th. We have cast our final votes, and next month we will be reading a fascinating historical biography focused on long-term skill mastery and individual determination.

subject: Package delivered to my house by mistake
body: Hey, the mail carrier accidentally left a delivery package with your name on it over at my front porch today. It looks like it contains some technical books. I'll leave it by your front door later tonight!

subject: Promo Offer: Get the absolute best virus cleaner app for free!
body: WARNING!! Your computer might be highly corrupted by dangerous external tracking modules!! Click this promotional download link instantly to install our completely free, unverified cleanup safety tool tool immediately!!

subject: Notice of Execution of Master Consulting Agreement
body: Dear Consultant, this message is a formal notice that our legal team has successfully executed the consulting agreement. Your project rates for RAG design ($65/hr) and Agentic Systems ($70/hr) are now locked in.

subject: Project Revisions: Introducing Document Summarization Layer
body: Hi, we want to expand the scope of our live data pipeline. We would like to introduce a new information extraction and summarization layer to process data chunks before they undergo embedding retrieval.

subject: Project Financing Offer: $35,000 Decision Support Architecture
body: Hello, our company is ready to commit $35,000 for a targeted engineering engagement to design an auditable, rules-driven decision support tool. Please reply with your availability to evaluate our existing dataset boundaries.

subject: Request for Architecture Strategy Meeting
body: Hello, I require a technical strategy meeting to resolve clear boundary definitions between automation and human control in our engineering setup. Let me know your open appointment slots for this week.

subject: Notice regarding prompt validation and system safety rules
body: Dear Partner, our legal compliance auditors have issued a notice requesting validation documentation for the prompt engineering security measures implemented in our system. We must confirm that all outputs remain strictly grounded.

subject: Curious about your AI values and approach
body: Hi, I'm really interested in understanding your core values around responsible AI development. What principles guide your work? Also, we do have a potential $200k project down the road, but that's probably 6 months out. Right now I'm just researching partners whose philosophy aligns with ours. No rush or meeting needed yet.

subject: Scheduling signed for $95k compliance tool - also pricing question
body: Hello, our CFO has approved the $95,000 compliance monitoring system. Please send over the final contract for e-signature by tomorrow. Also, just curious - do you offer any discounts for annual prepayment? Let me know when you've sent the documents.

subject: Your newsletter - loved the AI ethics piece!
body: Hey! Just wanted to say I really enjoyed your latest newsletter on AI ethics. That said, I'm also part of a nonprofit that might have a $10k budget for some consulting next quarter. But no pressure at all - mostly just wanted to say keep up the great writing!

subject: Quick methodology question (before our $40k kickoff)
body: Hi Victor here. Just a quick technical question - do you use DSPy or vanilla prompt chains for agent orchestration? We have a $40,000 signed agreement ready to go, but I'd love to understand your approach first. When can we hop on a 15-min call? Either way we're moving forward.

subject: Free meditation event this weekend (also maybe AI work?)
body: Hi! I'm hosting a free community meditation on Saturday at 10am - you should come! Also random question: do you do any AI consulting? My friend mentioned you might. No big project or anything, just idle curiosity. Hope to see you at the event!
